{{Quote|You're meeting a fellow called "Professor" Minnet, who leads a group of enterprising cargo transit specialists called Sidepocket.|Ging Darjeek to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] '''Minnet''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Minnet.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Minnet]]
Minnet was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
